title: Annual Interest Rate on Medicaid Plan Appeals by Claim Age — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims, Medicaid Managed Care Plan — interest rate on plan appeals.** The plan appeal's annual interest rate follows the age of the claim in calendar days from the date it reached the plan to today.

| Claim age (calendar days since the claim reached the plan) | Annual interest rate |
|---|---|
| More than 90 (the plan aged days) | 18 percent (plan aged rate) |
| More than 45 (the plan standing days), not more than 90 | 12 percent (plan standing rate) |
| 45 or fewer | 6 percent (plan base rate) |

## Boundary pairs

| Age | Rate | Age | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 91 | 18 percent | 90 | 12 percent |
| 46 | 12 percent | 45 | 6 percent |

## Hypothetical reading

A claim that reached the plan 70 days ago carries 12 percent a year; one that reached it 200 days ago, 18 percent; one that reached it 15 days ago, 6 percent. The age is counted to today.
